Main model: sonnet with diff edit format
> add a retry to the upload

I will wrap the upload call in a retry loop with exponential backoff so that
a transient network error does not fail the whole offer, and log each
attempt so the operator can see what happened when the hub was briefly
unreachable from the machine.

- retries: 3
- backoff: 250ms doubling

src/offer_cmd.rs
@@ -150,3 +150,7 @@
-    let resp = put_file(&url, token, &abs)?;
+    let resp = retry(3, || put_file(&url, token, &abs))?;
